name: Amounts And Value Date 4
definition: Specifies the value date and the amounts traded in a foreign exchange option trade.

CallAmount.name: Call Amount
CallAmount.definition: Call amount and currency of a foreign exchange option trade.

PutAmount.name: Put Amount
PutAmount.definition: Put amount and currency of a foreign exchange option trade.

OptionSettlementCurrency.name: Option Settlement Currency
OptionSettlementCurrency.definition: The single settlement currency for the payment made by the seller to the buyer if the option is exercised in case of a Non Deliverable Option.

FinalSettlementDate.name: Final Settlement Date
FinalSettlementDate.definition: Date on which the trade is settled, ie, the amounts are due.
